The reaction of the Chadian government was not long in coming Indeed, on Tuesday, October 27, N 'djamena denied any involvement in this operation and asked the Nigerien authorities to present the elements on which their accusations are based.

latest_events.title: Territorial aggression in Niger: Niamey accuses Chad and France after a drone strike and seizes the UN
latest_events.summary: On Tuesday, October 27, Chad rejected accusations from Niger, a neighboring country with which relations have been tense for several months. The latter accuses him of having killed two civilians in a "drone strike" on Nigerien soil with the "support" of France. Through its spokesperson, Gassim Chérif Mahamat, N’Djamena categorically denied Niamey's accusations about a drone strike on Nigerian soil on Monday, October 26 .

report_summaries.title: Territorial aggression in Niger: Niamey accuses Chad and France after a drone strike and seizes the UN
report_summaries.summary: In an official statement issued on Tuesday, October 27, 2026, the Government of the Republic of Niger denounced an airstrike that targeted its national territory on the night of October 24. Balance sheet, two civilians killed and several wounded. Directly accusing Chad and France, the Nigerien authorities announced a battery of diplomatic, judicial and security responses .

latest_events.title: Chadian drone strikes in Niger: CODDAE calls for increased vigilance at national level
latest_events.summary: Niamey, Oct 27 (ANP)- The Collective for the Defense of the Right to Energy CODDAE issued a press release on Tuesday, October 27, 2026, denouncing the aggression of the drone from Chad during the night of October 24 to 25 that hit the Emi Lulu area. This attack, the statement reports, “clearly seeks to open a new front against Niger and the Alliance of Sahel States (AES), which strengthens our sacred union” To this end, the Collective calls on the Nigerien population to strengthen national vigilance in the face of this attempt to sow terror.

latest_events.title: Mali: FAMa strike two terrorist positions
latest_events.summary: The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) announced that they had struck a suspected terrorist group on October 26, about 75 kilometers northwest of Léré, in the Timbuktu region. In addition, a second strike was carried out the next day in the Ségou region. The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) continue their operations against armed groups in the north and centre of the country Indeed, according to a statement from the General Staff of the Armed Forces, two strikes were carried out on 26 and 27 October 2026 as part of Operation Dougoukoloko, with the support of military partners.
sources: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)

report_summaries.title: Mali: FAMa strike two terrorist positions
report_summaries.summary: The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, successfully carried out two strikes against suspected terrorist groups in the Timbuktu and Segou regions on 26 and 27 October, as part of Operation Dougoukoloko, according to a statement from the General Staff of the Armed Forces According to the same source, the first operation was conducted on October 26, about 75 kilometers northwest of Léré, in the Timbuktu region.

report_summaries.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: two terrorist positions neutralized in the Timbuktu and Segou regions
report_summaries.summary: Bamako, October 28 (AMAP) The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, neutralized two positions of regroupment of terrorist elements on October 26 and 27, 2026, as part of Operation Dougoukoloko, announced Wednesday the General Staff of the Armed Forces According to the statement, the surveillance and reconnaissance operations carried out on October 26 made it possible to locate, about 75 kilometers northwest of Léré, in the Timbuktu region, about fifteen terrorist elements grouped under a shelter.

latest_events.title: Mali: thirteen civilians killed by an army drone strike, in the Timbuktu region
latest_events.summary: In Mali, thirteen civilians, including six children, were killed, on the night of Sunday to Monday, October 26, by a drone strike by the Malian army, near Lerneb, in the Timbuktu region, according to information verified by RFI from many local sources. The General Staff did not communicate about this strike . Published on: The Malian army is fighting, with its Russian partners in the Africa Corps, jihadist or pro-independence groups active in the country.
